notes.title: Mixtape
notes.text: Pick up movies or shows you love, then swipe through matching picks. Start one from Discover screen!

notes.title: Shared Lists
notes.text: Add followers as collaborators on your lists. Find lists you share in the new Shared tab.

notes.title: Smart Lists
notes.text: Start a smart list from a ready-made template, or turn lists that stopped updating into smart lists.

notes.title: Social Notifications
notes.text: Get notified about replies, mentions, reactions and new followers!

notes.title: Add From Lists
notes.text: Fill your custom lists with titles from your watchlist or other lists.

notes.title: More Smart Lists Filters
notes.text: Smart lists now filter by keywords, people, studios, languages, awards, ratings and more.

notes.title: Android TV Updates
notes.text: Revamped Search and Discover screens, more sorting options for lists, plus new ways to manage your lists, rate titles and add favorites.

notes.title: Reality Check
notes.text: See how closely true-story movies and shows follow real events. Open the Insights card on their page to find out.

notes.title: Profile Photo
notes.text: Upload or remove your profile photo right from Account Settings.

notes.title: Show Progress
notes.text: Tap the track button on a show to see your progress by season and mark single episodes or whole seasons as watched.

notes.title: Smart Lists
notes.text: Edit your smart lists from their page, or create one from the filters on trending, popular and watchlist screens.

notes.title: Soundtracks
notes.text: Movie and show pages now have a Soundtrack section. VIP members can play tracks right there with Spotify.

notes.title: History Cleanup
notes.text: Remove duplicate plays from your history. Go to Settings > History Analysis, pick which play to keep, and clean up in one tap.

notes.title: Exclude Filters
notes.text: Advanced filters can now hide genres, certifications, countries and statuses. Tap the minus next to any option to exclude it.

notes.title: Manage Lists
notes.text: Add anything to your lists straight from the long-press menu on movies, shows, seasons and episodes.

notes.title: Taste Match
notes.text: See how your taste compares with other members. Tap the match score on their profile to see your shared favorites and topics.

notes.title: Sorting
notes.text: Sort Progress and Continue Watching by title, release date, rating and more with the new sort button.

notes.title: Episode Lists
notes.text: Add episodes and seasons to your lists. Tap Manage lists in the episode menu, or the lists icon on the seasons screen.

notes.title: Person Credits Details
notes.text: Tap Shows, Movies or From My History on a person page to browse all their credits, filtered by department.

notes.title: Monthly Calendar
notes.text: Switch the calendar to a monthly view with the toggle at the top. Tap any day to see what's releasing.

notes.title: UI Refresh
notes.text: The app has a fresh new look with updated colors, icons and typography!

notes.title: Month in Review
notes.text: VIP members get a recap of last month on Home during the first week of each month. Tap it to see your stats.
